name: Yuuutsu Kyoushitsu
source:
Yuzuru Miyahara hated his classmate, Naofumi Sasame. Sasame was mean, sly and always on his high horse. Miyahara had been a victim of his bullying since they were kids. One day, Miyahara finds Sasame's weakness. He starts using it as blackmail and sexually abusing him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ299775.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
宫原结弦讨厌他的同学佐雨直文。Sasame很卑鄙、狡猾，而且总是趾高气扬。宫原从小就是他欺凌的受害者。有一天，宫原发现了佐雨的弱点。他开始用它来敲诈和性虐待他。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ299775.html]DLsite[/url]]
